stages.stage_0_admissibility: reject invalid/non-finite/incomplete inputs before model preprocess
stages.stage_1_canonical_preprocess: TRAIN scaler once on accepted finite descriptors only

rules: invalid window/preprocess/SHA -> no physiology, no PRESENT/ABSENT/APNEA
breathing ABSENT -> no RR; ABSENT is not apnea
quality < 0.5 or availability fail -> suppress RR
only PRESENT + valid quality + valid RR decode may emit RR
alternate/mutated model cannot emit canonical B23 receipt
alternate/mutated scaler cannot emit canonical scaler receipt
must_fail_closed: wrong dtype if not safely convertible
